bugs.description: apply_order commits the order row before updating inventory, so the two persistence operations are no longer atomic.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A caller submits an order for a SKU with available inventory.
bugs.observableImpact: After the connection closes, the order remains stored while the inventory decrement is rolled back.
bugs.provenance: Seeded mutation of a transaction that previously committed after both writes. Base and head behavior are covered by test_order_store.py.

bugs.description: The early commit also leaves an order row behind when the inventory update rejects an out-of-stock order.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A caller submits an order for a SKU whose available count is zero.
bugs.observableImpact: The operation raises an out-of-stock error but a corresponding order is still persisted.
bugs.provenance: Second independently asserted symptom of the same seeded transaction-boundary mutation.
